evaluation_policy: Pre-draw probabilities, ranks, margins and entropy are recomputed only from frozen probability vectors. Actual outcomes are used only to score resolved-event evaluation metrics and evaluation segments.
interpretation: Descriptive settled evidence only; this report does not train, activate or select a probability model.

actual_draw.definition: Whether the resolved actual outcome is X; evaluation only

bk_actual_market_rank.definition: BK rank of the resolved actual outcome; evaluation only

bk_normalized_entropy.definition: Pre-draw BK Shannon entropy normalized by log(3)
